newEntry.name: Sweep & Scribe
newEntry.desc: Snip twelve runners, bond a shouldered pivot in its foot and lower a lift-off compass beam to guide pencil circles. Customize reference-derived sheet fits, radius, bearing height and pencil bore; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL beam engravings, connected-card and clean-part STL/ZIP. Pencil and adhesive required; physical print and drawing accuracy untested.
